finding: Minimal pairs -- one word changed, meaning inverted -- embed closer together than many genuine paraphrases, so similarity alone cannot be pushed to a useful hit rate within the false-hit budget. The exact tier therefore carries the safe work and the semantic tier is calibrated to add only what fits in the budget. A production system wanting more would add a cross-encoder re-rank over the top-k candidates rather than lowering this threshold.

semantic.description: cosine similarity on pairs the exact tier did not resolve
